paragraphs: HUB Parking Technology develops, manufactures, installs and services smart parking systems, and handles after-sales support for them. It is the brand of FAAC Technologies dedicated to the parking and mobility industries. Its customers are operators running anything from single facilities to global networks.

The JUPITER product range covers the lane itself, with multiple combinations of entry and exit functions. Cabinets use full stainless steel construction. Jupiter is built to adapt to systems using license plate recognition, contract parking, credit card in and out parking, or online pre-paid parking. The range also includes automated pay stations, among them a cashless model. On the software side, JMS brings a parking operation into one cloud-based management system. Tools named J4Pay, J4M and J4H extend the operation beyond the lane.

The company dates its parking work to 1965. It calls itself one of the largest parking system manufacturers worldwide. Buyers are supported by direct sales representatives or value added resellers. The site sorts its offerings by sector on the premise that wherever a customer operates, there is a matching solution.
